short_desc_source.source_string: 既然选择了黑夜，便要留下血色的惊叹号——那是命运尽头最凄美的狂草。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: Since the Night has been chosen, a crimson exclamation mark must be left behind—the most tragically beautiful wild script at the end of fate.

short_desc_source.source_string: 住在最松软的那朵蘑菇里，整片森林都是麦香。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: Living in the softest mushroom, the entire forest smells of wheat.

short_desc_source.source_string: 宇宙有多大不重要，重要的是把它揉成了这一粒。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: The size of the universe doesn't matter; what matters is that it's been compressed into this single grain.

short_desc_source.source_string: 概率获得迅翼游侠套装、贵族系列武器皮肤等珍贵奖励_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

当星尘尚未散落，当浩劫还未降临。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

A skin designed for Sword series weapons.

short_desc_source.source_string:
该皮肤适用于重武器系列武器。
当星尘尚未散落，当浩劫还未降临。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english:
A skin designed for Heavy Weapon series weapons.
When the Stardust is still absent and the Starfall hasn't occurred.

short_desc_source.source_string: 世界熊熊燃烧，我纵情歌唱。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: The world is burning and my heart is singing!

short_desc_source.source_string: 迷宫的终点，是宝藏还是野兽？_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: At the end of the maze, lies treasure or beast?

short_desc_source.source_string: 回忆中，蝉鸣阵阵，新木长出嫩芽。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: In the memory, cicadas chirp incessantly, and fresh buds sprout from new wood.

short_desc_source.source_string: 宽大的帽围能够很好地营造出一种发量很多的假象。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: A wide cap that gives the illusion of voluminous hair.

short_desc_source.source_string: 据说邻居家的坏小子收藏着许多不同颜色的版本，准备干坏事的时候使用。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: Rumor has it that the bad boy next door has many versions of it, each for a different naughty occasion.

short_desc_source.source_string: 戴上墨镜，无畏荒野的狂风和黄沙。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: Keep the wind, sun, and sand out of your eyes, and look sharp while you're doing it.

short_desc_source.source_string: “叮咚——您的账户已接入——哔——”带着嚣张的面具，行走在无数数据和隐私构成的虚空网络中，全知全能。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: For anyone who still wants to live out the glory days of the information age, this is the ideal look.

short_desc_source.source_string: 保养困难的漆皮制品，大概只有强者才会在混乱的世道里穿着。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: The difficulty of maintaining lacquered leather products has made them a status symbol in this chaotic world.

short_desc_source.source_string: 头盔表面绘制有一对白色羽翼，或许是绘制者想要增强头盔的“庇护”效果。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: A helmet painted with a pair of white wings. Perhaps the artist's way of enhancing its protective aura?

short_desc_source.source_string: 不要畏惧利爪与獠牙。嚣张的气焰，才能点燃整个宇宙。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: ... Rawr.

short_desc_source.source_string: “看得出来，这只雏鸟很愤怒。”_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: "I can see the fledgling is angry."

short_desc_source.source_string: 没错，穿上它就能成为真正的“牛仔”！_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: This is where you say "yeehaw."

short_desc_source.source_string: “嘶吼吧！像再也看不到明天一样。”_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: "Roar! As if there's no tomorrow."

short_desc_source.source_string: 拥抱这场细雨。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: Embrace this gentle rain.

short_desc_source.source_string: 太棒了！我做到了！_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: Woohoo! That's what I'm talkin' about!

short_desc_source.source_string: 怎……怎么会这样？！_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: Woah, that scared me!

short_desc_source.source_string: 适时示弱也是一种生存法则。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: I'll do what I must to survive.

short_desc_source.source_string: 没办法，人生总是充满无奈。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: All hope is lost!

short_desc_source.source_string: 把掌声送给你，我的朋友。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: That deserves a round of applause.

short_desc_source.source_string: 天哪，我不愿面对这一切……_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: It's all getting too much!

short_desc_source.source_string: 加厚铁皮桶灌装的燃油，在混合燃油的基础上进行进一步提纯分离，燃烧更加充分高效。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: A thick metal barrel packed with fuel, took the basic mix and refined it even more for a burn that's extra thorough and efficient.

short_desc_source.source_string:
纵使即将燃尽，也要将一切阻碍之物尽数烧毁。简易武器，击中目标后会破碎并释放出其中的燃料,造成 #c2bfba4{1} + {2}%超感强度#n 的伤害,并留下火场，周围#c2bfba4{3}#n米范围内提升温度#c2bfba4{4}至{5}#n，持续灼烧其中的目标。
结构破坏力弱，对结构稳定度1级（银疫生物）十分有效，对结构稳定度2级及以上的伤害逐渐降低。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english:
When you're about to burn out, burn everything that stands in your way instead! A basic weapon that shatters and engulfs the target in flames upon impact, dealing damage equal to #c2bfba4{1} + {2}% Psi Intensity#n and leaving behind a burning field that reduces the temperature by #c2bfba4{4}–{5}#n within #c2bfba4{3}#nm, with moderate damage against buildings.
Low destructiveness against structures. Highly effective against structures of Lv. 1 Stability (Silver Plague creatures). Damage gradually decreases against structures of Lv. 2 or higher Stability.

short_desc_source.source_string:
高威力手雷，爆炸范围广。可以造成 #c2bfba4{1} + {2}%超感强度#n 的伤害，外围伤害减半。
结构破坏力弱，对结构稳定度1级（银疫生物）十分有效，对结构稳定度2级及以上的伤害逐渐降低。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english:
A powerful Grenade with a wide blast range. It deals damage equal to #c2bfba4{1} + {2}% Psi Intensity#n, which is halved at the outer ring. Low destructiveness against buildings.
Low destructiveness against structures. Highly effective against structures of Lv. 1 Stability (Silver Plague creatures). Damage gradually decreases against structures of Lv. 2 or higher Stability.

short_desc_source.source_string: 诱导星尘体细胞的加速合成，可以抑菌促进再生的神奇药液。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: A miracle cure that is both antiseptic and capable of accelerating the synthesis of somatic Stardust cells.

short_desc_source.source_string: 游隼负重翱翔于漫漫长夜，而在天之尽头迎接它的，却未必是黎明。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|2

reward_item.short_desc_english: The falcon's wings weigh heavy through the endless night, but what awaits beyond the horizon may not be dawn.

short_desc_source.source_string: 废土之上，荒野之间，自由竟然成为了人类最大的奢侈品。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: Out in the wasteland, freedom is now the greatest luxury for humankind.

short_desc_source.source_string: 或许，能够游离在规则之外的，才是真正的强者。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: It's time to master the art of living in a rule-free world.

short_desc_source.source_string: 狩猎者能否意识到，自己也不过是星辰之中的一头困兽呢？_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: Hunter or hunted? In the end, we're all just trapped beneath this vast expanse of stars...

short_desc_source.source_string: 这既是一场逃亡，也是一场新的征程。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: You're not just running away—you're embarking on a whole new adventure. Or that's what you like to keep telling yourself, at least.

short_desc_source.source_string: 挣脱牢笼的桎梏之后，你才能看到那超越维度的真理。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: In these shades, you feel like you can almost catch a glimpse of some deep truth that transcends dimensions. Or is it just a trick of the light?

short_desc_source.source_string: 肆意的狂沙之中，将不会有人知道救赎者的真面目。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0

reward_item.short_desc_english: In the midst of the wild, raging sands, nobody's gonna know who the redeemer really is.

short_desc_source.source_string: 打开礼盒可获得一个狂野·青龙或辉光·空之子，异能评级、活性评级在3-5级之间。最多9次必定获得异能评级为5、活性评级为5的狂野·青龙或辉光·空之子，两次保底不会重复。获取的异常物为绑定状态，不能进行丢弃或交易。_$S@TIDS$_cg0|0
